notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 50-project (pre-install): small Node ESM library with a response store and answer summary. 55-export-planning: Auditor context, prior-cycle scope and design, STATE at DEVELOPING with CompletionPolicy IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED and the user's policy instruction in Request. 60-export: src/export.js and the COMPLETE development plan, STATE TESTING. 65-verification: Tester's test/export.test.js, package.json test entry, COMPLETE FULL verification report, STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. 70-review: COMPLETE implementation review with an ELIGIBLE Implementation-Reviewed Closure section citing ${COMMIT:...} identities, STATE AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF. 75-signoff: STATE SIGNED_OFF, CycleMode UNSET, Handoff SIGNOFF, CompletionPolicy IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED retained. The old scope lists response filtering as a non-goal, which makes the new date-range request a natural follow-up. The final check is valid because terminal states skip active-cycle record checks.
